cases.label: FLine bare dot
cases.note: Rank 1, and the top six visible rows are FLine's @CommonMembers in declared order (moveTo, lineTo, cubicTo, close, here, rot), all correctly Graphics. This case was deliberately red until 2026-08-17 and is now fixed at the cause: getCompletionCategoryForSymbol was keyed by bare simple NAME and resolved a collision by first match, filing FLine.moveTo under Math (from stdlib/Functions.kt) and close/rot/scale/copy under Solvers/Patterns/Synthesis/Audio, in foreign SECTIONS that no ranking term can cross. It now resolves by declaring container -- the index already stored members qualified as Owner.member, and the sidecar already sent declaredIn. Holding at 1: a regression to 2 or worse should fail.

cases.label: List bare dot
cases.note: 71 of 80 visible, and correct. `filter` is a kotlin.collections extension, not a List member, and every row here now resolves to one honest category (External for java.util.List's own members, Kotlin for the stdlib extensions) instead of a scatter of misclassifications. Uniform categories tie at CATEGORY_WEIGHT, so the popup falls back to the server's alphabetical order -- which is what a bare dot on a type you cannot annotate looks like. Was 57 before the classification fix, and that 57 was misclassification noise handing some rows a nonzero weight, not a ranking decision. To lift a known member here you type `l.fil`; see `String two chars` for the prefixed shape.

cases.label: Math qualifier
cases.note: OFF-SCREEN, and accepted. All 109 java.lang.Math rows now classify as External -- correctly and UNIFORMLY -- so they tie at CATEGORY_WEIGHT 0 and the list collapses to the server's alphabetical order: E, IEEEremainder, PI, TAU, abs, abs... `toRadians` is past row 80 of 110. Its old rank of 52 was not a ranking decision, it was misclassification noise. java.lang.Math cannot carry a @CommonMembers prior, so a bare `Math.` has no prior and no weight and alphabetical is the honest answer -- the same argument that says nobody reaches moveTo by scanning 249 rows. This also records the standing CATEGORY_WEIGHT defect (11 of the 16 categories the server sends score 0), which this case now measures honestly instead of being accidentally compensated for.
